svg.title: How Sterimol B1 and B5 are found
svg.desc: Animation: a supporting line sweeps around the substituent cross-section; the minimum of its distance from the axis is B1, and the furthest atom reach is B5.
svg.text: Look down the L axis of the p-CF3-aryl arm. Sweep a supporting line around it.
half-width b(θ) as the line sweeps
L = maxᵢ (yᵢ + rᵢ) = 7.69 Å · B5 = maxᵢ (‖(xᵢ,zᵢ)‖ + rᵢ) = 3.21 Å
B1 = min over θ of the smallest half-width = 1.91 Å
